text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait to take part in the Arab League foreign ministers' meeting in Cairo on Sunday. Israel's decision to build a Jeiwsh settlement in Arab East Jerusalem will dominate discussions.
- Italy's Prime Minister Romano Prodi will visit Kuwait on April 23.
- Kuwait's 1990-91 Gulf crisis compensation body to pay $11.3 million to claimants in April.

- A Kuwaiti criminal court senteced a Sri Lankan woman to death for murdering her husband's second wife. The verdict is yet to be reviewed by the courts of appeals and cassation. All death sentences require endorsement by the country's Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange index rose 5.5 points on Saturday to 2,215.9 points.

- Some 500 expatriate teachers will lose their jobs. The Ministry of Education plans to make the teachers redundant by the start of the next scholastic year in September to make room for Kuwaiti employes.
